The '''Quartermaster Corps''',<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> known simply as the '''Quartermaster''', was a section of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic]]. It was part of the military bureaucracy alongside the [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|New Republic Defense Force Fleet Command]], [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]], and the [[Technology Section]].<ref name="CTD" />
